title: Article. The Invisible Competitor: When Creating Value is Better than Fighting for It

reader_summary.headline: Hello and welcome to the Synopsis, a Speedwell Research Podcast.
reader_summary.overview: Hello and welcome to the Synopsis, a Speedwell Research Podcast. My name is Drew Cohen and today on the Synopsis we are going to be reading one of our recently released memos. Now this memo is really interesting because it kind of touches on a few ideas that have been floating around before.

key_points.text: The consumer hierarchy of preferences, the PETA network, which if you don't remember what that is, don't worry.
key_points.evidence_quote: The consumer hierarchy of preferences, the PETA network, which if you don't remember what that is, don't worry, we don't talk about it in details, but it's the same sort of ethos that comes up in this memo as well.

key_points.text: And it's also interesting because this discussion mirrors part of the discussion we just had with Evolution's Todd Househalter which will be released next week..
key_points.evidence_quote: And it's also interesting because this discussion mirrors part of the discussion we just had with Evolution's Todd Househalter which will be released next week.

key_points.text: And so I really enjoyed writing this memo, but if you prefer to read this memo instead of listen to it.
key_points.evidence_quote: And so I really enjoyed writing this memo, but if you prefer to read this memo instead of listen to it, just go to speedwellmemos.com, it is available free there.

key_points.text: And without further ado, let us begin.
